title: Halloween Event 2026
content:
[[File:HalloweenEvent2026.png|thumb|355x355px|The brand-new thumbnail for the event]]
The Halloween Event 2026 is one of the current events in Murder Mystery 2 which was officially launched on October 18, 2026 at 3:00 PM EDT and ends on November 16, 2026. This event is inspired by the retro theme with witch based Halloween Lobby. The event includes 1 new map, new weapon box, new Battle Pass of 30 tiers, the return of [[Candies (2026)|candies]] {{Currency|Candies2026|25px}}, 2 new ancients, 3 new godlies, 3 new chroma godlies, and 2 chroma ancients. 

== Overview ==
Players have to gather [[Candies (2026)|candies]] {{Currency|Candies2026|25px}} so that they can get special rewards. The candy can be spent on buying a battle pass where players have to pay 800 [[Candies (2026)|candies]] {{Currency|Candies2026|25px}} for each tier except the first tier which does not cost anything and the ancient weapon which costs 100,000 [[Candies (2026)|candies]] {{Currency|Candies2026|25px}}. Thus, the total cost of the battle pass would come out to be 117,400 [[Candies (2026)|candies]] {{Currency|Candies2026|25px}}. Apart from that, the player can spend their coin on Halloween box which costs 600 [[Candies (2026)|candies]] {{Currency|Candies2026|25px}} and has 12 weapons. However, there are no coins that will drop during this event. The coins will reappear once the event is over.

== Battle Pass ==
[[File:HW26BPLogo.png|thumb]]
The Battle Pass features 30 tiers, each costing 600 [[Candies (2026)|candies]] {{Currency|Candies2026|25px}}. The first tier is free, and after buying the last tier, the [[Ancient Weapons|ancient]] gun [[Emberbow]] costs 100,000 [[Candies (2026)|candies]] {{Currency|Candies2026|25px}}. There is also a very rare chance of getting the [[Chroma Emberbow]].

== Lobby ==
The '''2026 Halloween Event''' took on a retro-styled lobby inspired by Murder Mystery 2's classic lobby from 2014-2018. Substantially smaller than the typical halloween lobby, it is also inspired by the classic haunted house map created by Shedletsky in 2006. The voting area takes the design from the house's exterior and interior, and it features season appropriate decor. Above the voting pads, there is a balcony-area with a secret room above, accessed by a secret puzzle. To unlock the room, players must click the skulls around the lobby in rainbow sequential order. The skull mesh derives from the classic Riddling Skull accessory, uploaded by Roblox in 2008. The lobby's seasonal NPC dons a purple and orange ''Doomsekkar'' inspired accessory. Behind the NPC is The Cauldron, used for crafting the event's items.

== The Cauldron ==
The '''2026 Halloween Event''' re-introducted crafting with event weapons via The Cauldron. The cauldron is located behind the event's NPC in front of the buildings on the left side of the lobby. During the event, players must obtain both the box godly, [[Embersickle]], and the battle pass final reward, [[Emberbow]]. By putting these items in the cauldron, players receive Emberscythe. There is also a low chance of obtaining [[Chroma Emberscythe]], one of the first two Chroma Ancients, when crafting.  Players are free to craft as many times as they please, as long as they have the required materials.

== Quests ==
There are 2 categories of quests: Daily and Event. Daily Quests reward more [[Candies (2026)|candies]] {{Currency|Candies2026|25px}} from collecting [[Candies (2026)|candies]] {{Currency|Candies2026|25px}}, acting as a compliment to the main way of collecting Snow Tokens. There are 3 daily quests available each day of the event, which refresh accordingly at 8:00 AM UTC, or 3:00 AM EST. Event Quests reward the player with exclusive items for completing Daily Quests. 

== Bingo Challenge ==
In the 2026 Halloween event, there is the implementation of the Bingo rewards system for the first time since the 2023 Easter Event. This reward system uses a 3x3 grid, where players will be required to complete challenges in order to obtain rewards which include the effects and toys.

The event also brought back all previous halloween-themed maps, those being [[Manor]], [[Farmhouse]], [[Mineshaft 2|Mineshaft]], [[Barn (Infection)]], [[Vampire’s Castle]], and [[Spaceship]]. 

== Gamepasses ==
The Mortal Bundle is the limited time offer that takes place once every year at the occasion. The full package will cost you 3,399 Robux, and this will allow you to acquire the godly knife [[Mortal]], the godly gun [[Immortal]], and also the unique effect [[Smolder]]. Both the knife and gun can be acquired separately, costing 1,699 Robux.

</gallery>Like other seasonal events, trophies can be collected through collecting coins on the map. The reward system is in the form of podium reward, as well as blue versions of the rewards going to the top 100 players. For the Halloween 2026 event, eligible users will receive reskinned versions of the [[Emberbow]]

== Trivia ==
*This is the 12th yearly Halloween event.
*The theme of the event is similar to the early days of MM2, with the small lobby and the Haunted House map.
*This event introduces the first chroma ancients, which are [[Chroma Emberbow]] and [[Chroma Emberscythe]].
*This is the first event, since the release of season 1, where players could craft an ancient weapon
*It's the comeback of Bingo System after the [[Easter Event 2023]] (Egg Collecting) and the [[Halloween Event 2015]] (Role Tasks).
*It is the first event where the final battle pass item is placed in the ancient category after the [[Christmas Event 2024]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Ancient Weapons|ancient]] [[:Category:Guns|gun]] obtainable by purchasing the 30th tier during the [[Halloween Event 2026]] for 100,000 [[Candies (2026)|candies]].

== Appearance ==
Taking the shape of a crossbow, it has a royal purple and gold color scheme. The stem of the bow is purple, and moving up has an orange and yellow interior. The string is gold, and the bow's grip to the stem is a light purple. At the head of the bow is a purple and gold pumpkin head, similar to the lobby NPC, as well as the other Ember items from the update. The outside limbs are royal purple, interwoven with orange to create a royal color scheme.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Godly Weapons|Godly]] [[:Category:Knives|Knife]] obtainable by unboxing it from the [[2026 Halloween Box]].

== Appearance ==
Taking the shape of a classic sickle, it features a purple and gold handle with a pumpkin head in the middle. The blade has gold and purple detailing, and the blade is a light steel color.

== Trivia ==
*This pairs with the first ancient to have a chroma variant, [[Emberbow]].
*This has a chroma variant under the name [[Chroma Embersickle]].
*This, along with [[Emberbow]], are required to craft [[Emberscythe]].
*This is the first sickle-shaped weapon in the game.
**Additonally, this, along with [[Candy]], [[BattleAxe]], [[BattleAxe II]], [[Bat]], [[Turkey]], [[Evergreen]], and [[Heart Wand]] are the only godly "[[knives]]" that do not resemble knives.{{GodliesNav}}
